name: Uedem (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Uedem (a red castle on white).
history: The municipality bears a banner striped lengthwise red, white and red and a hoisted flag striped horizontally red, white and red.

features.role: Uedem arms — red castle on white
